tools.name: extract_gst_invoice
tools.title: Extract GST invoice
tools.description: Extract structured Indian GST invoice fields (invoice no, date, customer, GSTIN, place of supply, invoice value, per-rate rows, and per-line HSN/SAC items) from raw invoice text. Input the plain text of the invoice (e.g. copied from a PDF).

invoice_text.description: Raw invoice text to extract. Should include tax lines and totals.

file_name.description: Optional file name for context only.
